🚀 v1.8.3 Direct AI SMS Response Pipeline:
• ⚡ Direct SIM SMS Reply: AI conversational responses are dispatched directly from the HTTP response pipeline via WorkManager, completely bypassing external cloud push delays
• 🛡️ Anti-Duplicate Pacing: Intelligent 20-second debounce prevents duplicate replies across FCM and direct triggers
• 🔄 goAsync() Lifecycle Guardian: Background BroadcastReceiver protected against premature Android termination during AI response generation
• 💬 Real-Time Conversational Chat: Inbound customer texts receive intelligent appointment booking answers immediately
